messages:
sre-olivia: Heads up — big remote_write ingestion spike in cortex-usw over the last 10m. Prom queue length jumped, p95 write latency up ~3x. Looks correlated with a batch GPU provisioning job that ran at 08:12 UTC.
infra-raj: copying logs now, thx. which pool was scaled?
sre-olivia: batch autoscale touched nodepool-gpu-ephemeral-usw, ~120 nodes created in ~5m.
monitoring-zoe: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/c/GPU/remote-write-ingest (shortlink) — see series cardinality graph, top label is `gpu_serial`.
monitoring-zoe: quickly ran prometheus label-cardinality query, top offenders: `gpu_serial`, `nv_serial`, `container_id`.
oncall-bot: ALERT RemoteWriteQueueHigh fired for prom-usw (firing: 3m) :rotating_light:
sre-miguel: probable cause — we’re ingesting per-GPU unique serials as labels. ephemeral nodes get unique serials and create new series per node. That explodes series churn.
infra-raj: ah, the provisioning script annotates pods with GPU serials (we added to help debug device mapping). I can stop that, but need a relabel plan so we don't reintroduce later.
sre-olivia: short-term: drop gpu_serial and nv_serial in scrape relabeling before remote_write. Long-term: change annotation to aggregate (gpu_count) or hash to low-cardinality.
monitoring-zoe: proposed relabel (canary it in prom config for one scrape job):
```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_gpu_serial]
    regex: .+
    action: labeldrop
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_nv_serial]
    regex: .+
    action: labeldrop
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_gpu_count]
    regex: (.+)
    action: replace
    target_label: gpu_count
    replacement: "$1"
```
infra-raj: that looks fine. we'll also remove the annotation from the provisioning job to stop future churn.
sre-miguel: additionally we should tune remote_write queue config to be more resilient while we fix relabeling. e.g.:
```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: https://cortex-usw/api/prom/push
    queue_config:
      max_samples_per_send: 10000
      batch_send_deadline: 1s
      capacity: 25000
      min_backoff: 30ms
      max_backoff: 1000ms
```
monitoring-zoe: and add a short-lived alert suppression: mute RemoteWriteQueueHigh for 30m in the us-west escalation policy while we roll the relabel.
sre-olivia: miguel — can you run a quick query to list top 20 label keys by cardinality so we ensure we catch other unique tags?
sre-miguel: running: `topk(20, count by (__name__, label)({__name__=~".*"}))` — will paste results in a sec.
sre-miguel: paste: `gpu_serial: 18.2k, container_id: 7.4k, pod_uid: 6.1k, host_id: 4.9k`
monitoring-zoe: for pod_uid/container_id we already drop in relabeller for kube_sd, but provisioning created annotations that got promoted. need to check our SD relabel order.
infra-raj: action: revert provisioning annotation step, push relabel change to canary prom-usw-01, validate 15m, then roll. I’ll open a quick PR.
sre-olivia: action: update Grafana SLO dashboard panels to include series churn panel and set a 5%/30m baseline for alerts.
sre-miguel: action: run a one-off job to backfill and compact metrics with high churn tag removed? (just investigating cost impact).
monitoring-zoe: note for ops runbook: include `labeldrop: gpu_serial|nv_serial` and a checklist to validate relabel ordering (kube SD -> annotations -> labeldrop -> target relabel).
infra-raj: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/4321 — deploying canary now.
sre-olivia: moving to monitor, thanks all. please ping here when canary validated or if we need to rollback. :thumbsup:
monitoring-zoe: canary metrics look good after 12m: series churn down ~92%, remote_write queue drained, alerts cleared.
infra-raj: provisioning job fixed to emit `gpu_count` only, removed serial annotation.
sre-miguel: follow-up: we should add a linting check in CI to block high-cardinality annotations (warn on new annotation keys matching *_serial or *_id).
sre-olivia: agreed — filed tech debt ticket #INF-9812.
monitoring-zoe: closing loop: I'll update pager policy and Grafana panels.
oncall-bot: Incident resolved: RemoteWriteQueueHigh (was firing) — duration 18m.
